title: Transparent backgrounds for GPT Image
summary:
Transparent GPT Image backgrounds, text ads that heed preferences and conversation history, and another batch of community-built projects.

The image API added `transparent=true` for GPT Image generation and editing. It defaults to false, so existing requests keep their current background behavior.

Authenticated users’ `show_ads=false` preference now skips text-response ads. Ad insertion also checks conversation history before adding another, while sponsor and support messages received clearer labels and formatting.

The project lists gained Spanish-language presentation and memory-game tools, study and Telegram assistants, and Minecraft agent projects. The root README was also restored and expanded.

highlights.title: Transparent GPT Image backgrounds
highlights.text: Add `transparent=true` to GPT Image generation or editing requests to get a transparent background. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Text ads respect preferences
highlights.text: Authenticated text requests now skip ads when your `show_ads` preference is false.
